title: POST /join request body, version 1
description: A player asks the Spine for a seat at a named table, creating the table if the name is new. Besides the four fields below, every other property is the seat's decoration: it becomes the payload of the seat.joined event and is validated against payloads/seat.joined.v1.json (deckName is both a field here and part of that payload).

joinRequestId.description: An opaque idempotency key meaning 'this particular join attempt'. A retry sends the same value and gets the same seat back, whatever else the retry says. The Spine attaches no other meaning to it and never interprets it.

name.description: The table's name. An unseen name creates a table; a known name joins it.

playerName.description: The player's display name. Not unique; the seat's own id is what identifies it.

deckName.description: The deck's display name, carried into the seat.joined payload.
